benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: This card appears to fall behind when it comes to offering any substantial value-back across lifestyle-related categories. For instance, some similar cards like Axis Rewards and IDFC FIRST Wealth credit cards come with slightly better rewards rates of 3.2% and 2%, respectively. However, their rewards programs and lounge access features are also accompanied by other benefits like milestone bonuses, insurance coverage, and discount offers on common spending categories, including dining, food delivery, movies, etc., which add to the overall savings that the card users can get.

faqs.q: Why am I not able to redeem the reward points against Standard Chartered Rewards Credit Card outstanding balance?
faqs.a: You must have at least 1,000 Standard Chartered reward points to initiate their redemption against your credit card statement.

faqs.q: Is there any redemption fee levied on my Standard Chartered credit card reward points?
faqs.a: Yes, a rewards redemption fee of Rs. 99 is charged whenever you redeem your Standard Chartered credit card rewards.

faqs.q: Where can I check my earned reward points using the Standard Chartered rewards credit card?
faqs.a: You can check your reward points balance that you have earned via transactions done using the Standard Chartered Rewards card either on the monthly credit card statement or on the 360 Rewards portal.

faqs.q: Is there a capping on reward points earning on Standard Chartered Rewards Credit Card?
faqs.a: Yes, the bonus 4X reward points earned on monthly retail spends above Rs. 20,000 are capped at 2,000 reward points per month.
